subject: Post-demo: cost qualification & benchmark ask
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Alyssa Chen <alyssa.chen@nebulacloud.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-18T15:22:00-07:00
Subject: Post-demo: cost qualification & benchmark ask

Hi Alyssa,

Thanks again for taking time to run through the Redwood demo today — great discussion. Per our call, I wanted to capture the key asks and three quick questions that will let us tailor a pricing option you can evaluate with procurement.

Recap / asks from the demo:
- You showed the Nebula ingestion flow and the anonymized user prompts. Good signal for batching and prefix caching.
- You want predictable per-token economics with the ability to move to dedicated capacity if volume warrants.
- Procurement wants a target $/1M tokens to benchmark against OpenAI/Anthropic and other hosts.

Three quick questions (can reply inline):
1) Target monthly token volume range (low / expected / high) — we used sample projection on the call but want confirmed numbers.
2) Target price you want us to beat or meet ($/1M tokens).
3) Any procurement constraints (term length, PO required, vendor onboarding timeline) and procurement contact.

Attachments: I attached a short unit-econ workbook (redwood_unit_econ_1m.xlsx) with two pricing ladders (hosted vs dedicated) and a template you can drop sample token rows into. If you can send a single week of representative request logs (CSV) that would help us produce a custom forecast.

Next steps I propose:
- You share the numbers and procurement contact (Tom?).
- We will run an internal cost run and share a 3-line pricing proposal plus a pilot offer (3 months).
- If numbers align, we'll prepare a mutual action plan and a DocuSign engagement for the pilot.

If you prefer, loop Tom on this reply and I can have our pricing lead join a 30-minute follow-up tomorrow.

Thanks — I’ll stand by for numbers.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0128

[Attachment: redwood_unit_econ_1m.xlsx (spreadsheet)]

From: Alyssa Chen <alyssa.chen@nebulacloud.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Redd <tom@procureco.com>, Procurement <procurement@nebulacloud.com>
Date: 2026-07-18T16:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo: cost qualification & benchmark ask

Jordan — thanks, this is perfect. Quick answers below and I attached a small sample of our usage (nebula_usage_sample.csv).

1) Monthly token volume (approx):
- Low: 40M tokens
- Expected: 150M tokens
- High: 400M tokens (after Q4 ramp)
Peak qps: ~12 requests/sec, median sequence length ~220 tokens.

2) Target price: our procurement team wants us to come in below current host contracts. Were benchmarking to roughly $10-15 per 1M tokens as a target range. Anthropic/OpenAI numbers we're seeing sit at ~18-25/1M depending on endpoint. If you can show a credible path to ~$10/1M at steady-state volume (or a blended pilot price), we can fast-track reviews.

3) Procurement notes:
- Standard 12-month contract preferred but pilot-friendly (3 months) is OK.
- PO will be required for production contracts.
- Procurement lead: Tom Redd (tom@procureco.com) — hes copied.

I attached the CSV. Let me know if you need any more breakout columns.

Cheers,
Alyssa Chen
Director of Product, Nebula Cloud
alyssa.chen@nebulacloud.com
[Attachment: nebula_usage_sample.csv (csv)]

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Alyssa Chen <alyssa.chen@nebulacloud.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-18T18:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo: cost qualification & benchmark ask

Thanks Alyssa — this is exactly the detail we needed. Quick, high-level benchmark and proposal options so you have context for procurement:

Benchmark (public/typical list price ranges for text gen, ballpark $/1M tokens):
- OpenAI (gpt-4-style endpoints / managed): ~20-25 $/1M (varies by endpoint and batch).
- Anthropic (claude-style managed): ~18-22 $/1M.
- General open-model hosts (managed, smaller infra pools): 15-20 $/1M with lower SLA and higher latency.

Where Redwood lands (what we can credibly offer):
- Hosted API (self-serve): starting list ~14 $/1M for steady usage band; volume discounts start above 100M tokens/month.
- Dedicated pool (reserved capacity): for your expected band (150M->400M) we can present committed tiers that land in the $8-12 $/1M range depending on commitment length and caching profile.
- Pilot blended offer: 3-month pilot at an introductory blended $/1M target of $10/1M (caps on monthly usage to avoid overrun), with a defined step-down to $9/1M for any committed 12-month contract above 300M tokens/month.

I attached a short price-options PDF (redwood_price_options.pdf) and I ran a quick blended unit-econ in the attached workbook — you can drop in the CSV you sent.

If Tom wants to run procurement checks, we can draft a 3-month pilot SOW and an optional follow-on committed schedule. Shall I draft the short MAP and shared DocuSign for the pilot so Tom can start the PO process?

Next actions I propose:
- Jordan: draft MAP + pilot SOW and share by Monday.
- Marissa: if you agree on pilot pricing, Ill include a line for finance margin and approval path.
- Rishi: please confirm whether the expected median sequence length and caching assumptions keep the dedicated execution cost in the $8-12 range.

Thanks — were aligned on timing if procurement wants to move fast.

Best,
Jordan
[Attachment: redwood_price_options.pdf (pdf), redwood_unit_econ_1m.xlsx (spreadsheet)]

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-19T09:07:00-07:00
Subject: Internal: Nebula Cloud pricing — approve pilot discount?

Marissa / Rishi,

Quick internal: Alyssa confirmed expected band (150M expected, 400M high) and target $10-15/1M. I proposed a pilot blended $10/1M for 3 months with step-down to $9/1M on a 12-month 300M+ commit. Two asks:

1) Marissa: can we support the pilot at $10/1M from a commercial/discount standpoint? Wed be below hosted list but its a pilot to convert a high-velocity customer. If yes, Ill prepare the MAP and the DocuSign.
2) Rishi: confirm engineering assumptions — with median seq 220 and prefix caching on their ingestion, does dedicated occupancy and KV cache gains make $8-12/1M credible at their expected volumes? Any red flags on qps or model selection that change this?

If you both sign off today Ill create the HubSpot deal (link below) and loop Tom for PO language. Ill also attach the pilot SOW draft in the HubSpot file.

Action items:
- Marissa: approve pilot commercial terms or propose counter. (owner: marissa_cole)
- Rishi: confirm perf/cost assumptions (owner: rishi_malhotra)
- Jordan: draft MAP + SOW and create HubSpot deal NB-4782 (owner: jordan_blake)

HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/678901/NB-4782

Thanks,
Jordan
Account Executive
